directive.quote: finish the trillion-launch-video port so the repo can be retired

targets.baseline_commit_message: grade-and-repair-speech-audio: byte copies of the speech-grading plan reader and the voice-take checks (port baseline)

preserve: a plan segment with a clip is a cut to grade; one without (a generated line) is not
a clip's media file is the plan's sources[clip], else the source its <clip>.words.json names
word times are the clip's whisper result (segments[].words[] word/start/end) first, else the word file's words, in source seconds
a cut shared by plans is graded once and shown in every plan that uses it
allowed_deltas: the plans, word files and whisper-result folders are arguments instead of one film's folders in the repository
it writes the spans file the grade reads, with groups (one per plan) the grade writes groups/<plan>.json from, instead of the grade reading plans itself
banned_substitutions: a second spans-file reader beside read-data/spans.py
word times read from anything but the plan's own word files
_old_copy: The old copy leaves the private repository on its own branch once the Mac parity run (out/speech/mac-parity) says EQUAL.
